name: Roblox
author: Aura
description: Shows the Roblox game you play on your profile, with your avatar. Nothing to set up.
uses: Whether Roblox is running, and its log file, for the game you are in and your user ID
Details games write to that log for Bloxstrap's rich presence (BloxstrapRPC)
Roblox's public game, avatar and image pages online, for names and pictures
